rationale.A: ~640 m in mixed traffic on tram streets (Porthaninkatu, Aleksis Kiven katu, Fleminginkatu); 5 lights
rationale.B: Quiet Kallio side streets (Läntinen Brahenkatu, Kirstinkatu, Kolmas linja); only 70 m on Helsinginkatu, but two unsignalised crossings
rationale.C: Quiet streets via Kirstinkatu/Kolmas linja, but 230 m on Porvoonkatu incl. 140 m with tram rails
rationale.D: Same as C with a one-block jog via Itäinen Papinkatu
rationale.E: Like C but finishes on quiet Toinen linja, avoiding the Siltasaarenkatu crossings; 3 lights
rationale.F: Mostly paths and quiet streets, but 250 m on Fleminginkatu (150 m tram) and some Aleksis Kiven katu traffic
rationale.G: No traffic: Kotkankatu/Tivolitie then the Eläintarhanlahti path; 1 light, but three unsignalised crossings incl. Aleksis Kiven katu twice
rationale.H: All bike path, no traffic, though about half is beside 40 km/h roads; +5 min

notes: G at +3 min removes all of A's tram-street riding and saves 4 lights, so it gets both cards. H is slightly calmer but costs 2 more minutes for a marginal gain.
